SSC GD Exam Irregularities: Two Directors Arrested

The Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF) has arrested two directors of ASSESS Infra Pvt. Ltd., a company involved in selecting exam centers and security audits for the SSC GD Constable Recruitment Exam-2026. The arrests are part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in the exam. The company's directors were apprehended by the Noida unit of the STF. Reports indicate that a total of 10 individuals have been apprehended so far in connection with the case. The irregularities are reported to have spread across seven states.
